standard_prerequisites.name: Torsion free modules over a valuation ring are flat

standard_prerequisites.name: Descent of etaleness along a faithfully flat ring map
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Descent, Lemma descent-lemma-descending-property-etale, used at proof lines 8603-8607
standard_prerequisites.use: Concludes that A -> B is etale, hence that the quotient Z is Spec(A).

core_obligations: Base change the whole diagram to Spec(A) and reduce to the case Y = Spec(A), replacing X by a quasi-compact open subspace containing the image of |Spec(A')| (proof lines 8535-8551).
Show that the scheme theoretic image Z of Spec(A') -> X is reduced, quasi-compact and separated over A (proof lines 8554-8560).
Prove Z_K = Spec(K) using flat base change of the scheme theoretic image and the closedness of a section of a separated morphism (proof lines 8561-8576).
Choose a surjective etale V = Spec(B) -> Z, show B -> C = B tensor_A A' is injective, that A' -> C is etale, and that C and B are torsion free, hence flat, over A (proof lines 8579-8593).
Compute V x_Z V = Spec(B tensor_A B) by showing the canonical surjection becomes an isomorphism after inverting K and that both sides are torsion free (proof lines 8594-8602).
Descend etaleness of A -> B along the faithfully flat map A -> B, conclude Z = Spec(A) and produce the required arrow Spec(A) -> X (proof lines 8603-8612).
difficulty_reason: Counts the author Lemma: for a separated morphism f : X -> Y of algebraic spaces over a scheme S and a diagram of the shape used in the valuative criterion with K contained in K' arbitrary, the dotted arrow exists (source lines 8520-8532). The proof is a genuine algebraic argument, not a formal consequence of separatedness: after base changing to Spec(A) it replaces X by the scheme theoretic image Z of Spec(A') -> X, proves Z_K = Spec(K) by the flat base change of that image and the fact that a section of a separated morphism is a closed immersion, then chooses a surjective etale V = Spec(B) -> Z, shows B is torsion free hence flat over the valuation ring A, computes V x_Z V = Spec(B tensor_A B) by comparing with B' after inverting K, and descends etaleness of A -> B along the faithfully flat map A -> B.
